findings.title: Orders: scenario sizing
findings.message: At 3× traffic in “Black Friday”, HPA hits its maximum of 10 at 80% CPU of request (target 70% CPU of request), but an admission quota still refuses 22,437 requests with a higher maximum. More capacity can't add allocation.

findings.title: Every request goes through one Orders
findings.message: It runs 1 replica, and every request from Traffic goes through it: if it stops, Traffic gets nothing.

agentReport.simulations: Played 1 saved simulation (at most 60 s each; some stopped there).
agentReport.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
